responseChannel: approved control plane or named owner handoff

provide: approved Provider or proof model and public version
verified source and destination chain IDs
verified contract addresses and explorer links
token symbol, decimals, mint-burn or lock-release authority
finality, fee, refund and outage policy

provide: approved HSM, MPC or threshold signer reference
limit, pause, rotation, revocation and emergency-exit approvals
inputs.prohibited: Do not provide private key material, seed phrases, PEM files or raw HSM credentials.

inputs.prohibited: Do not provide wallet secrets or unrestricted withdrawal authority.

provide: review scope bound to source and artifact digests
findings, remediation and explicit acceptance or rejection

releaseRule: Missing evidence keeps only the affected capability false. Public read-only evidence and unsigned downloads must never be promoted to executable, production-signed, canonical, trustless or Mainnet status.
